analysis.reason: RSI 51.5에서 61.6으로 상승하며 중립 구간 안착 확인. MACD 히스토그램 0.1544에서 1.7964로 개선되며 강세 확산 신호. 5일 연속 Higher Low 패턴 유지로 상승 추세 강화.

[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (51.5→61.6): 과매도 탈출 후 중립 구간 안착 판단, 상승 방향성 확인
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (0.1544→1.7964): 개선 진단, 강세 추세 전환 신호

[지지·저항 구조]

· 스윙 저항선 ($334.99): 돌파 시 추가 상승 여력 확보
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low): 상승 추세 지속 확인
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.48배): 움직임의 신뢰도 위축
· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세): 매수 진입 조건 충족, 단기 저항 돌파 확인 필요
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($325.66) vs SMA5/20/50 ($320.38/$312.03/$313.39): Diagnosing short-term/mid-term trend above moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($301.59/$282.89): Assessing mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (84.1%) + Current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.5→61.6): Diagnosing exit from oversold into neutral territory, confirming upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.1544→1.7964): Improving, signaling a bullish trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $324.49): Approaching upper band, with a 7.99% band width suggesting potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($319.35): Support confirmed based on Pivot (PP $318.21).
· Swing resistance ($334.99): Breaking through resistance to unlock further upside potential.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low): Confirming continuation of the uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.48x): Indicating subdued confidence in the price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Buy entry conditions met, requiring confirmation of short-term resistance breakout.
